title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 56. Calls for the EU and its Member States to strengthen inclusive and high-quality education for all young people, from early childhood education through higher education, VET and lifelong learning, to prioritise support for learners at risk of early school leaving and disengagement and to reduce financial and practical barriers to access, while fully respecting the competences of the Member States for the organisation and financing of their education systems;
